_readme: The one config source for this site. scripts/new-site.mjs fills it in; edit by hand after that. `game.official` must be the real store link (roblox.com/games/<placeId>/... or store.steampowered.com/app/<appid>/): the daily patrol reads it to notice game updates the site has not caught up with. `entity.path` must match the folder name under src/app/ (rename both together).
description: Working What If Disasters codes with the exact reward for each, a tier list, a page for every unit and a short beginner guide. Fan-made, every number has a source.
